settings.headline: Eight ways to give
settings.intro: There is no donation form on this site. Every way to give below is arranged by post, by bank or by talking to Sofia at the station.

items.title: By check
items.text: Make it payable to Hathermouth River Rescue and post it to the station. Write the appeal on the back if you want it to go to one.

items.title: Bank transfer
items.text: Call the station for our bank details. We never send them by email first.

items.title: Monthly gift
items.text: A standing order from your bank. $10 a month keeps a crew member in drysuit seals for a year.

items.title: Payroll giving
items.text: Give from your salary before tax, if your employer runs a scheme.

items.title: Employer matching
items.text: Many employers match gifts or volunteer hours. We can send a receipt your employer will accept.

items.title: A gift in your will
items.text: Margaret Ellwood, our larger boat, was a gift in a will. A conversation with Sofia is confidential and commits you to nothing.

items.title: Fundraise for us
items.text: Run, swim, bake or shave. We send a bucket, a T-shirt and a crew member if we can.

items.title: The station shop
items.text: Every mug, chart and tea towel pays for kit. Open weekends and holidays at the slipway.

settings.headline: Where each dollar went in 2025
settings.intro: From the 2025 accounts (fictional figures). Restricted appeal money is spent only on what the appeal was for.
settings.foot: Every crew member, trustee and shop volunteer is unpaid. The charity employs one part-time operations manager and one part-time volunteer coordinator.

items.a: In the story, Hathermouth River Rescue is a registered public charity, and the treasurer sends a receipt for every gift. This is a fictional example.
No running costs come from government. The flood boat was part-funded by a county grant; everything else is given by people and local businesses.

items.q: Can I give to one thing?
items.a: Yes. Name the appeal on your check or tell us when you call, and the gift is kept in a restricted fund.

items.q: How do I stop a monthly gift?
items.a: Cancel the standing order with your bank. There is nothing to cancel with us.
